groupDistance.basis: Every member sits at the cluster's Cosmicflows-4 group distance (table 3, DMzp), as the Nearby Universe places the members Cosmicflows-4 holds, spread in depth as widely as the members spread across the sky: that the cluster is as deep as it is wide is an assumption, not a measurement of any member's depth.

table.note: Column 4 is RC3's numerical stage of each galaxy's FCC morphology (members.mts): E and dE -5, S0 and dS0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5, Sd 7, Sm 9, Im and BCD 10; a type left open between two classes has none.

sample: The 202 of the Fornax Cluster Catalog's 255 definite members (p2tbl2, membership code 1) that Cosmicflows-4 does not hold: the other 53 are within 10 arcsec of a Cosmicflows-4 galaxy the Nearby Universe field draws. Positions are the catalogue's B1950 positions through Astropy's FK4 to ICRS transformation.
meaning: Fornax Cluster member galaxies from the Fornax Cluster Catalog (Ferguson 1989) that the Nearby Universe field does not draw, one dot each at Fornax's Cosmicflows-4 group distance, in the colour of its type. Drawn when the cluster is selected.

endsNm.basis: The Sc template's optical spectrum ends at 766 nm. Cutting the other four templates at 766 nm leaves each colour the same to the sRGB step (checked 2026-09-29), since the eye's response there is under 0.1% of its peak.

missing.label: no type
missing.basis: The D65 white point: a galaxy with no measured type is drawn without a colour.

toneBy.band: B (the FCC's total blue magnitude BTmag), not corrected for extinction
toneBy.basis: The Nearby Universe field's tone scale (its galaxies' recipe), so a member is as bright as a field galaxy of the same absolute magnitude: each galaxy's absolute B magnitude (its B magnitude minus the group's distance modulus) darkens its colour, from full at M_B -21.5 to 30% at -17.5, linear in magnitude. Galactic extinction toward the cluster, about 0.1 mag in B, is not removed.

fullDetail.basis: Presentation choice: whole within 100 Mpc of the Sun, where the Nearby Universe draws its field whole, so every member shows while the cluster is selected (the bank's origin is the Sun; the renderer's default of 10 kpc suits a galaxy's own dots).

classBasis: Class bounds are the midpoints between the de Vaucouleurs numerical types the templates stand for (E -5, S0 -2, Sa 1, Sb 3, Sc 5); types later than Sc take the Sc template, the latest in the atlas.
